notes:
Account summary: Cerulean Shelf Insights runs product search for a large European retailer network (omni-channel). Primary objective is replace hybrid TF-IDF + heuristic reranker with embedding-based retrieval + learned reranker to improve relevance and conversion while keeping cost per query <= $0.002 target at scale. They have ~18M SKUs in catalog (including marketplace partners), but expect searchable subset of ~10M with seasonally peaky traffic (5x Nov-Dec).

POC details / results so far:
- Ingested 2M SKU sample (attributes + image embeddings + product description). Used Redwood hosted API for embeddings and reranking during POC.
- Evaluation: MRR uplift 9% on top-10; CTR up 3.2% on product detail view in test cohort. Latency: average endpoint p50 ~70ms, p95 ~220ms with hosted default settings for combined retrieval+rerank. They want p95 <120ms for rerank+serve in production.
- Cost sensitivity: finance team set internal KPI ~ $0.0015-$0.002 per query end-to-end (embedding + retrieval + rerank). They explicitly asked about batching, quantization, and cheaper quantized reranker variants.
- Model preferences: willing to use open models; prefer option to pin specific model versions. Interested in model routing: cheaper embedding model for warm cache, higher-quality for cold queries.
- Operational: need EU data residency, SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration for keys.

Quotes / call notes:
- "We can tolerate some small drops in immediate relevance if it halves cost during Black Friday." - Head of Search
- "Need a clear rollback path and canary for the holiday period; if latency spikes we must fall back to current service." - Platform Eng lead

Next steps (assigned):
- Redwood: provide Dedicated sizing + price sheet for sustained 5x peak, propose batching + cache config to meet cost target (action: Javier, due 2025-03-10).
- Cerulean: confirm legal/data residency requirements and share SSO metadata (action: Legal + Infra, due 2025-03-14).
- SE (Priya): design canary rollout + fallback policy doc; map endpoint SLA and observability hooks.
